messages:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — PR #24891 (storage/kv-shard) is green on linux but windows e2e is flaky. We have a DB migration blackout starting 2024-10-03 22:00 UTC. Looking to land before that window if possible. Can folks help with approvals + reruns?
Maria Lopez: link? also is the flake consistent or intermittent?
Alex Chen: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/24891 — windows failure is `kv_integration.TestRebalance` intermittently times out. Logs: https://ci.internal/build/54321
Jorge Kim: saw that one yesterday — looks like a timing/scheduling flake. Re-run usually clears it. I can trigger a rerun now but it'll go to the end of the queue.
ci-bot: Rerun queued for build 54321 — triggered by @Jorge Kim. Queue position: 48.
Sam Patel: heads-up from release side — please avoid landing inside the migration blackout. If you can't get it stable before 22:00 UTC, we should schedule a canary earlier or punt.
Taylor Nguyen: I can give approvals once tests are green and small nits addressed. I'm OOO starting 2024-10-03 16:00 UTC though.
Priya Reddy: I can take an approval pass today after lunch (ETA ~3h). If you need a fast +1 now for unblock, add me as reviewer and ping.
Alex Chen: @Ravi Shah are you available to give final storage owner eyes? there's one perf-related comment in the review that Ravi raised.
Ravi Shah: quick look — the perf comment needs a tiny change (avoid copying buffer in hot path). I can approve once Alex pushes a 1-line fix. If time's tight, I can do a follow-up revert later but prefer the fix now.
Alex Chen: will push small fix in ~20m and request re-run. Thanks @Ravi Shah.
Taylor Nguyen: ping me once CI is green — I'll +1 after a look. Also prefer landing before 19:30 UTC to avoid last-minute rollback risk.
Jorge Kim: rerun finished: all linux jobs green, windows flaky test retried and passed on second attempt (build 54321#2).
ci-bot: Build 54321#2: SUCCESS — triggered by @Alex Chen after push 7d9c2a1.
devops-bot: Merge queue position updated: PR #24891 now at position 3 for canary lane. Estimated earliest merge: 2024-10-03 18:45 UTC.
Sam Patel: propose canary at 18:45 UTC and hold full rollout until we validate DB migration prechecks. @Priya / @Taylor please coordinate the final +1s.
Priya Reddy: I'll review in 30m and can grant +1 if the small fix is in.
Taylor Nguyen: saw the push, quick glance looks fine. giving +1 pending CI green (which it is).
Alex Chen: pushed the fix (7d9c2a1) and marked as `ready-to-merge`. Thanks everyone — I'll monitor the canary and report back. If any rollback needed, tag me directly. :thumbsup:
Ravi Shah: approved. Good catch on the copy.
Sam Patel: copying this thread into the release checklist. Good coordination — let's avoid landing during migration blackout unless absolutely necessary.
Alex Chen: noted. I'll post a short canary status update in here after 30m. Thanks all.
